detail.intent: Analyse how employment in Singapore's technology sector changed annually from 2020 to 2024, including overall direction and growth patterns.
detail.sector: Technology sector, assumed to mean SSIC 2020 Section J: Information & Communications.
detail.rationale: The request asks for employment trends over a defined period, so the plan focuses on annual employment levels and changes from 2020 through 2024. Because “technology sector” is not a formal statistical category, it is mapped to SSIC 2020 Section J: Information & Communications as the working assumption.
